sources.calibration: Canvas render modes are Screen Space Overlay, Screen Space Camera, and World Space; Overlay is independent of scene camera and resizes with resolution.
Canvas.renderOrder is read-only; Unity documents ordering caveats for Screen Space Camera and World Space.
Use contrast and target-size guidance as design calibration only; CSS pixels do not automatically equal Unity logical pixels.

authority: External calibration only; project source and runtime evidence remain authoritative
staleWhen: Unity 2022.3 UI documentation, WCAG 2.2 guidance, or the project UI contracts change
